messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] Sev2 — elevated p99 latency on /v1/generate across hosted cluster us-west-2. p99=2.5s (SLO=1.2s), error rate spike to 1.8%. Paging: @jonas @lee @mira

mira: seeing it too. lots of small spikes across multiple pods. queue depth climbing on inference-proxy. grabbing top logs now.

jonas: oncall here, taking. mira can you paste the top proxy logs and HPA status?

mira: logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T09:02:11Z proxy INFO req_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=2340 queue_ms=1800 target_pod=p-47
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z proxy WARN req_id=def456 backend_err=timeout code=504
2026-03-15T09:02:13Z proxy INFO req_id=ghi789 route=/v1/embed latency_ms=120
```
HPA: inference-deploy targetCPU=70% current=85% replicas=8 min=2 max=50
```

lee: HPA is spiky — looks like the scaler didn't react fast enough for the workload shape. also seeing a lot of requests with long context length causing KV-cache churn on the runtime.

jonas: ok mitigation plan: 1) turn on routing fallback to smaller model for non-SLAd tenants, 2) apply short-term prefix rate-limit for anonymous/unknown routes, 3) scale up dedicated pool manually while we investigate autoscaler thresholds.

mira: doing step 1 now — enabling routing rule `fallback_to=gpt-medium-qa` for route tag `untrusted`

mira: command run: `rdwctl routing update --route untrusted --fallback gpt-medium-qa --timeout 1200ms`

oncall-bot: Deployment event: routing rule update started by mira (request id r-789)

lee: applying a short token-rate limit for `/v1/generate` from anonymous sources: `proxy-ratelimit set --route /v1/generate --limit 40req/m --burst 5`

emily: tagging customer-impact: jumped p99 and some batch jobs retried. I notified support to hold off on wide emailing until we have root cause. AcmeCorp ingestion jobs hit 50% failures earlier (they reported).

jonas: scaled dedicated pool temporarily: increased dedicated-gpu-pool to 20 replicas (was 8). Command: `k scale --replicas=20 deploy/dedicated-gpu-pool -n inference`

sre-watchbot: Autoscaler events: last scaling action 09:01:44Z -> scaled from 7 to 8. Skipped scaling between 09:01:50Z and 09:04:00Z due to cooldown.

jonas: that cooldown is probably the culprit — our HPA cooldown and custom metrics smoothing too aggressive for bursty traffic.

mira: after routing fallback and rate limit, p99 dropped to 0.95s, errors back to 0.2%. monitoring shows steady improvement.

lee: confirmed. rolling CPU threshold change to 60% and reduce cooldown to 20s for HPA on inference-proxy. I'll open PR for config change.

jonas: note for post-incident: add a canary job that runs synthetic long-context request pattern to exercise KV cache and autoscaler interplay.

emily: customer comms: suggested short note to AcmeCorp that we saw transient latency and some retried jobs; ops followed up and we restored service. keeping them updated.

amy: can we get a quick root cause summary for leadership? want to be clear on whether infra config or model behavior caused this.

jonas: initial RCA: bursty long-context requests -> KV cache churn -> sustained higher CPU on a subset of pods -> HPA smoothing prevented fast scale-up -> queueing at proxy -> elevated p99. Secondary contributor: routing allowed heavy requests to the shared hosted pool instead of dedicated burst pool.

mira: remediation checklist (live):
- reduced HPA cooldown to 20s (lee)
- created routing guardrail to prefer dedicated pool for long-context requests (mira)
- applied temporary rate limits for anonymous routes (lee)
- scaled up dedicated GPU pool to absorb traffic (jonas)
- support notified, AcmeCorp FYI (emily)

jonas: immediate action items (owners + due dates):
- `infra#1234` HPA config change PR (lee) - due EOD today
- `serving#987` implement canary long-context synthetic load test (jonas) - due 3/22
- `routing#222` add rule to tag long-context requests and route to dedicated pool (mira) - due 3/18
- `alerts#55` add alert for sustained queue_ms > 800ms for 3m (emily/ops) - due 3/19

mira: scheduling postmortem — propose 3/17 10:00am PT (30m), invite SRE/Serving/Infra/Product. link: https://calendar.redwood/meeting/195321-pm

amy: add brown-bag share: 3/24 11am PT — "Autoscaler lessons + routing patterns". please prep 15m demo of new canary tests.

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/12345 — HPA cooldown -> 20s, cpu target -> 60%. reviewers: jonas, mira

jonas: verified telem after changes: p99 stable ~0.9s, error rate ~0.15%. marking incident contained.

oncall-bot: Incident status -> CONTAINED at 09:28:19Z, page silenced.

mira: handing off to day team: notes: watch for recurrence in next 72h, verify canary long-context job runs hourly, confirm routing guardrails deployed to prod by 3/18, confirm AcmeCorp follow-up complete.

emily: support follow-up checklist: send customer note by EOD, offer to replay failed batches, include timeline.

jonas: closing loop: will own postmortem write-up, will include timeline, root cause, and required config changes + tests. tagging owners above.

amy: thanks team. prioritize the canary and alert — those two should stop this from surprising us again. brown-bag will be great for sharing prevention patterns.

mira: thanks everyone. final handoff. leaving ops channel for the day team. :white_check_mark:

sre-watchbot: Follow-up reminder scheduled: postmortem draft due 3/16 17:00 PT, canary test delivery due 3/22.

lee: noted. I'll follow up on reviewers.

jonas: last note: add a test case in our nightly e2e for route tagging + fallback behavior.

emily: adding action items to the incident board now.

oncall-bot: Thread closed by mira at 09:46:29Z.
